title: Resolution urging MTA to add good jobs standards to subway car deal
summary: This resolution calls on the Metropolitan Transportation Authority to include transparent, enforceable “good jobs” standards in its request for proposal to buy up to 2,390 new subway cars, covering wages, benefits and workforce training. It also urges manufacturers receiving large contracts under the RFP to sign community benefits agreements with affected communities. The RFP, released March 19, 2026, is part of the MTA's $68 billion 2025-2029 capital plan.
